metadata.methods_description: Participants studied 25 lists of word pairs (6 pairs per list) presented visually for 4000 ms with 1000 ms interstimulus intervals. Each encoding phase was followed by a distractor task (arithmetic problems) and a cued recall phase where participants had 5000 ms to vocally recall the paired word. Intracranial electrophysiological recordings were acquired using multiple systems and referenced either monopolarly (typically mastoid) or bipolarly according to paired electrode schemes. Monopolar recordings should always be re-referenced before analysis. All voltage values have been standardized to volts across recording systems.
